title: Console home: Recently accessed lists records and views, beside the activity feed
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `1b3b5b102`, `/home` at 1280 px: "最近访问" (`HomeContinue` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx`, fed by `useRecentItems` / `RecentItemsProvider.tsx`) shows one item, the dashboard "高管总览", after a session that opened the Account list, the record Acme Corporation, a flow and two Studio pages; records and list views are not recorded, so the block that should bring the user back to the last record never does. The activity feed beside it is a bordered card with five rows and "查看全部动态".

## Target

Section ④ of the artboard "系统首页 · 四段式", in numbers:

1. Two columns, `minmax(0,1fr) 360px`, 24 px gap, headings 15 px / 600.
2. "最近访问": a card with up to six 40 px rows: a 24 px icon tile by kind (record → the object's icon, dashboard, list view, page), the title 13 px, and a 12 px muted trail "客户 · HotCRM · 10 分钟前" (object label · app label · relative time). Records and list views are recorded when their page opens, with the object label and the app, in the same store the sidebar reads; the store keeps the last 20 and dedupes by target.
3. "活动动态": the existing feed in a card with 12 px padding; each row "actor 13 px / 500 · verb and target muted · 12 px time and object"; "查看全部动态 →" as the last row. The column renders only when the caller may read `sys_activity` (objectui#12081), and the recent block then spans the full width.
4. Empty "最近访问": one muted line "打开过的记录和页面会出现在这里".

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx` (`HomeContinue`, `HomeActivity`), `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecentItems.ts`, `packages/app-shell/src/context/RecentItemsProvider.tsx` (record and view entries), the record and list pages that call it, `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: opening a record page records it with object label and app; the home lists it first with the kind icon; the store holds at most 20 and dedupes; without `sys_activity` the recent block is full width.
2. Screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark, as measurements in the PR text.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- The sidebar's recent list reads the same store; it gains the record entries too and must still render.
- Lands after the hero-and-launcher card (same file).

## Evidence

The artboards, as static HTML and 1280 px PNG renders, live on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `c4dfb417a`, never merged; the maintainer ruled that design files and screenshots do not enter main). Files: [Home.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/c4dfb417a/docs/design/console-home-login/Home.png?raw=true) · [Home.html](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/c4dfb417a/docs/design/console-home-login/Home.html?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 review of the console login page and home page with the maintainer, on objectui main `1b3b5b102` and HotCRM `63db83e2`. The maintainer approved the artboards in that session, verbatim: 「同意设计稿，创建任务」.</sub>
